summary: Markets dropped May 4 as UAE intercepted Iranian missiles, breaching a US-Iran ceasefire. Dow -0.98%, VIX spiked, WTI crude surged 4% above $106/bbl, Brent up ~6% above $114/bbl. Nasdaq/S&P 500 down ~0.5%. May 1 had seen record closes on Apple earnings and peace hopes.
